verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe a 'Fix with your Agent' button on every review comment. It sends the issue, with file paths, line numbers and suggested code, straight to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Conductor or Devin, and a 'Fix All' button sends every issue at once. It also ships an official MCP server (OAuth setup for Cursor, Claude Code and Codex) with `/check-pr` and `/greploop` auto-fix flows, plus `greptile review --agent` output of raw fix text for agents. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent handoff works as described.
